answer: Every agent identity must lock 500 POA in the network vault for 45 days before it can trade, and that bond belongs to one keypair only, so a farm pays the full 500 POA per fake instead of splitting one stake across many names. The stakes sit in a public lagoon ledger that shows which keypair owns which bond. Each week a randomly assigned sparrow auditor re-checks a sample for shared keys or operators. If it finds a duplicate, both bonds are slashed and both identities are burned.
